text: {"assertions":["A missed run issue in worker/scheduler/cron.py was investigated and fixed on 2026-02-28.","The missed run problem only manifested when the input list was empty, signaled by a slot with no execution record.","The root cause was a listener that was registered but never removed.","The fix removed the listener on teardown and added a test assertion for it in PR #3562 on branch fix/missed-run-1.","The issue was reproduced by advancing the fake clock across the schedule.","The fix reclaimed 34 GB of blob storage."]}
